question: Related Questions Q. asslam o alaikum, i saw dream in which i was locating my shoes suddenly someone said that they were of silver colour shining they are down the table. i took it and they were very shining of silver white colour i wore it .when i was wearing my shoes i saw my right shoes a very little damaged as if one side leather ribbon was out. but i wore it.than i was having something in my hand which was napak and i tried to wash from tape near by of house.but the lady called me what ru doing than i didnt throw in her dustbin. i saw big dustbin in middle of their small row of houses.i tried to go their when i was almost near dustbin suddenly a mad girl attacked me.[plz reply as i have heard that shoes represent spouse and i am single. 1284 views Q. Assalam-o-alaykum, I saw today morning in my dream that one of my friend is weeping and telling me that he has got a very bad disease and I am thinking (in that dream) is that disease happened to me too or not. Please help me in this regard. Assalam-o-alaykum. 1412 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Ma' salam. 1856 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum Warahmatullahe Wabarakatuhu Mofti sahb, I am in circumstances where I have to take some very important decision. The situation is that I am living in Dubai, UAE with my family. I got married in 2007 and Allah Blessed me with a daughter this year. My wife, daughter and mother all live with me here in Dubai. My father was died long back and I am taking care of my mother. As you know, due to increasing inflation it is very difficult to save some money. I could not save any single dirham for last two years since when I came here in dubai.and also sometime a satuation come that it becomes very difficylt to pass the month in my earning So I am thinking whether to keep my family here with me and keep living without saving any money and just trust on Allah that situation will get better or if I send my family back home (Pakistan), I can save reasonable amount every month. So before making the final decision, I decided to do ''Istikhara'' as sunnah. Yesterday night, I abolute and offered two nawaffil and then recite dua for correct guidance from Allah SWT and then slept without talking to anybody. I saw a dream that I want you to give me ''tabeer'' for. I saw that I am standing by a closed grave which is made of white marble (and I felt in dream that this is my own grave). I am dusting the grave and I am saying to my wife with so much grief that how would you live without me (meaning that when I will go into the grave). That''s it. I don''t know whether this dream is meaningful or not. Or it has any connection with ''Istikhara'' but I simply request you to please guide me on this. Jazakumullaho khair. 1489 views Q. In my dream I think to myself, how that is possible, as I am not married nor have I committed the haram (zina). Later when I arrive home, the child is alone with me: his name is Idrees, and he is so beautiful that for a second I wonder if he is a girl: The child is very healthy, white skinned, has blond hair, and with colorful (very light green, close to blue) eyes. Then I think if he is my child, then I will be able to breastfeed him because I should have milk in my breasts. I offer my left breast, and the baby accepts? then I try my right breast, and again he accepts. I quickly stop, and kiss the child?s mouth? then I woke up. 1731 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31018 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Dream Question: Assalaamu alaikum to all members of Darul Iftah. Please interpret this dream : In Madinah Shareef, there is a Lady I know who is from the family of Prophet Muhammed (sallaawhu alaihi wa sallam). I never went to her house. One night, Just before Fajr Azaan I dreamt that I'm in this lady's house and I want to do her khidmat. I was worried for her because she had many guests over her place and I told her that I want to wash the dishes for her but she wasn't letting me do it, then I insisted and just started. Thats it, then I woke up during Azaan. Assalaamu alaikum Answer ID: 31018 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 776/496//H=1432) It is nice dream, ma-shaAllah. It means that you will be elevated in sincerity, service of people and your love towards the Prophet (Allah bless him and give him peace). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
